main_measure.name: OLS slope of 30-bar excess return on forecast (forecast > 0 grid bars)
main_measure.threshold: slope t >= 2 with mean excess > 0 confirms; t <= -2 rejects; at least 30 cases

supporting_check.name: mean excess 30-bar return on break bars (minus coin's mean 30-bar return) > 0

decided_by: Only 10 grid bars with forecast above 0, fewer than the plan's minimum of 30 cases.
reading: The coin's mean 30-bar return is the mean over all its windows' non-overlapping 30-bar grid returns (positions 0, 30, 60, ... with a full 30 bars ahead), and the plan's fewer-than-30-cases rule is reported as 'not observable' per the workflow's minimum-count rule.
